## RecordSdk type

The SDK type of a record with `Fields`<!-- -->: a readonly object whose required fields are always present and whose optional fields may be absent.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type RecordSdk<Fields extends RecordFields> = {
  readonly [K in Exclude<keyof Fields, OptionalFieldNames<Fields>>]: RecordFieldSdk<Fields[K]>
} & {
  readonly [K in OptionalFieldNames<Fields>]?: RecordFieldSdk<Fields[K]>
} extends infer Shape
  ? {
      [K in keyof Shape]: Shape[K]
    }
  : never
```

**References:** [RecordFields](./contracts.recordfields.md)<!-- -->, [OptionalFieldNames](./contracts.optionalfieldnames.md)<!-- -->, [RecordFieldSdk](./contracts.recordfieldsdk.md)

## Remarks

With `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`<!-- -->, an optional field means "may be absent", not "may hold `undefined`<!-- -->". (Encoding still treats an own property holding `undefined` as absent, because values can bypass static types.) The required and optional halves are merged into a single object type so that editors display the record as one shape.
